'''Solomon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Makeb]], Solomon also shared his knowledge of investigation with others.
